description:
Load a world countries dataset and use the Field Calculator to compute GDP per capita.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Add the vector layer located at /home/ga/GIS_Data/natural_earth/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp.
3. Open the layer's Attribute Table.
4. Toggle editing mode (pencil icon) and open the Field Calculator (abacus icon).
5. Create a new field named 'gdp_per_capita' with output field type 'Decimal number (real)'. Set the length to 20 and precision to 2.
6. Calculate the field using this formula: ( "GDP_MD_EST" * 1000000 ) / "POP_EST"
   (Note: GDP_MD_EST is in millions of US dollars, so we multiply by 1,000,000 to get raw GDP, then divide by population).
7. Click OK to calculate.
8. Save edits (click pencil again and save).
9. Export the result as a CSV file to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/countries_gdp_per_capita.csv (Right-click layer > Export > Save Features As > Select CSV format).

Ensure the final CSV contains the new 'gdp_per_capita' column populated with values.
